# 🚀 Release v0.4.1

## Upstream changelog:
- fix: match Trakt watched markers across IDs @tapframe
- feat: add selectable app icons @tapframe
- fix: split plugin source cache from metadata (NUVIO-MOBILE-1) @tapframe
- fix: dispatch playback service starts off main (NUVIO-MOBILE-Q0) @tapframe
- fix: skip redundant Trakt watched refresh (NUVIO-MOBILE-Q3) @tapframe
- fix: serialize watched state snapshots (NUVIO-MOBILE-PW NUVIO-MOBILE-PY NUVIO-MOBILE-Q2) @tapframe
- fix: contain Trakt watched rate limits (NUVIO-MOBILE-Q1) @tapframe
- fix: preserve large Trakt watched responses (NUVIO-MOBILE-Q4) @tapframe
- remove expanded action button shadow @tapframe
- fix: route Kitsu/MAL IDs for skip intro and correct AniSkip types query @Sumanth1602
- Improve Greek (el) localization coverage

# 🚀 Release v0.4.0 - New SIMKL Tracking

## Upstream changelog:
Introducing SIMKL as a new native tracking provider @tapframe @skoruppa
- fix: handle torrent cache pressure on Android @tapframe
- Take videoid from meta for track services in progress items @skoruppa
- fix(search): remove recent history icons @tapframe
- Add badges to TmdbEntityBrowser @skoruppa
- Add Slovak language strings for settings and features @mmsw91
- Update Slovak translations for parental content strings @mmsw91
- Fix "mark as unwatched" for whole series @skoruppa
- fix(auth): sanitize authentication errors @tapframe
- fix(profiles): activate selected profile once @tapframe
- fix(trakt): restore seek scrobble updates @tapframe

## Enhanced changelog:
- All changes from the upstream
- Refactor subt

# 🚀 Release v0.3.2

## Upstream changelog:
- feat(auth): register official client devices @tapframe
- Update Play account and foreground service compliance @tapframe
- fix(ui): clip CardDepthEffect sheen overlay to shape path @quiettinkerer
- refactor: remove catalog header accent line @tapframe
- feat(library): search the cloud library @Laskco
- feat(mdblist): add MyAnimeList (MAL) rating from MDBList API @guuilp
- fix: per-profile isolation for Trakt auth and storage @guuilp
- fix(android): correct fill/zoom image based subtitle rendering @darkflame91

## Enhanced changelog:
- All changes from the upstream
- fix(ios): subtitle opaque-box @luqmanfadlli 
- feat: add Live TV tab to floating pil navigation @luqmanfadlli
- fix(android): fix ExoPlayer playback not starting @luq

# 🚀 Release v0.3.1  —  Native P2P streaming comes to iOS

## Upstream changelog:
- fix(navigation): defer route cleanup until pop completes @tapframe
- feat: integrate Nuvio Engine @tapframe
- fix: recycled bitmap crash in Now Playing metadata @KhooLy
- fix(settings): normalize section headings @tapframe
- feat: add separate upcoming continue watching row @tapframe
- fix: apply poster depth to remaining surfaces @tapframe
- feat(library): add sortable shelf and grid layouts @tapframe
- support for split ABI @tapframe

## Enhanced changelog:
- All changes from the upstream
- feat(playback): add adjustable subtitle background transparency @luqmanfadlli 
- fix(ios): subtitle background opacity @luqmanfadlli
- feat: add episode rating toggle in TMDB Enrichment @luqmanfadlli

# 🚀 Release v0.2.25

## Upstream changelog:
- fix: disable predictive back on Android @tapframe
- ref: remove contribution summary @tapframe

## Enhanced changelog:
- Added Library Grid View @luqmanfadlli

**Nuvio Enhanced:**

- Fix Android Picture-in-Picture behavior @darkflame91
- Fix library synchronization du

**Nuvio Full:**
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luqmanfadlli/NuvioMobile-iOS/main/NuvioFull.json
```
**Nuvio Enhanced:**

```

## Upstream changelog:

**Added Features:**

# 🚀 Release v0.2.22

This release is based on the upstream **Nuvio v0.2.22**, see official release details [here](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/releases/tag/0.2.22).

---

## Variants

### Nuvio Full
This variant is similar to the official TestFlight version with unlocked Plugins and in-app Trailers.

### Nuvio Enhanced
This custom variant includes experimental features, quality-of-life improvements, and specific bug fixes not yet available in the upstream repository.

**Added Features:**
* Added Now Playing Control in the Notification, Lockscreen, and Widget with media metadata and artwork.
* Added a volume boost feature (up to 200%) for quieter streams.
* Added support for Live TV integrations.
* Added stream quality selection in Player Control.
